0022600208.text: The Houston Rockets, 7-2 through nine games and 4-1 at home, host the Denver Nuggets (5-3, on a two-game winning streak), with Houston 1st in the Southwest and 3rd in the West. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and in 2025-26 the Rockets lost the season series 1-3, including a 129-93 loss in Denver on March 11. Houston will be without Clint Capela (ankle sprain) and Steven Adams (calf strain), while Denver will be without Julian Strawther (knee sprain).
